notes.title: Demo Patch #4
notes.content:
Greetings,

While working on the full-game release of Escape from Hadrian's Wall (coming later this year), we made a few updates to our demo.

Here are the highlights:

French Localization

Added new hints and tutorials, so players don't get stuck

Improved interface for save/load game, inventory, settings, etc

Fixed various bugs, updated VFX, and improved lighting in several areas

If you haven't played it yet, now is a great time. And don't forget to wishlist the full game!

Thanks!

Jim

notes.title: Demo Patch #3
notes.content:
Hi!  
We just pushed another small patch to our Demo!  This is mainly to make the Roman God Mosaic Puzzle a little more readable.  Some of the elements of that puzzle were hard to see clearly.  Hopefully this patch improves things!

We also included a few VFX fixes!

Thanks!
Jim

notes.title: Demo Patch #2
notes.content:
Hi!  

We just pushed a small patch to our Demo!  This is mainly a visual update --- some improvements we've been wanting to make.  Hope you enjoy the beautiful new artwork!

 Updated Air Golem Animations and VFX
 Siege Scene VFX improvements to the missles launches, etc
 Added power-up and power-down VFX for the Elemental Golems
 Added cute hearts when you pet friendly Fire Golems
 Pole and Wall Torches flicker randomly, for visual interest
 Improved imagery for the "The Key to the Roman Gods" card.
 Various lighting improvements
 Various bug fixes


Thanks!
Jim
